doc_class_description: A Sri Lanka Cabinet Decision is an official policy or action agreed by the Cabinet of Ministers, shaping governance, law, and national development in the country.

latest_doc_d.description: Hosting the 14th Commonwealth Women's Affairs Ministers Meeting
latest_doc_d.decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-10-26 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
latest_doc_d.decision_details_body: - The Commonwealth Women's Affairs Ministers Meeting is a highlevel international meeting that provides an opportunity for Commonwealth member countries to hold policy dialogues with the aim of promoting gender equality and the empowerment of women, exchange experiences and good practices and strengthen cooperation among member countries. Sri Lanka has agreed to hold its 14th meeting in Sri Lanka. Ministers in charge of the subject of women's affairs of member countries, senior Government officials, representatives of recognized civil society organizations and representatives of relevant stakeholder institutions are scheduled to participate in that meeting. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Women and Child Affairs to host the 14th Commonwealth Women's Affairs Ministers Meeting in Sri Lanka in the first quarter of 2028, was approved by the Cabinet.
